// --- TOAD LISO EXPORT ---
void CreatureSystem::BuildDetailedToad() {
    m_meshVertices.clear();

    // PALETA DE COLORES
    glm::vec3 colSkinBelly(0.850f, 0.800f, 0.600f);
    glm::vec3 colSkinMain(0.450f, 0.380f, 0.220f);
    glm::vec3 colEyeGold(0.800f, 0.500f, 0.100f);
    glm::vec3 colBlack(0.020f, 0.020f, 0.020f);
    glm::vec3 colWart(0.350f, 0.250f, 0.150f);

    auto addBox = [&](glm::vec3 p, glm::vec3 s, glm::vec3 r, glm::vec3 c) {
        this->GenerateBox(p, s, r, c);
    };

    // Abdomen
    addBox(
        glm::vec3(0.000f, 0.300f, 0.000f),
        glm::vec3(0.650f, 0.350f, 0.800f),
        glm::vec3(-0.100f, 0.000f, 0.000f),
        colSkinBelly
    );

    // Espalda
    addBox(
        glm::vec3(0.000f, 0.500f, -0.050f),
        glm::vec3(0.600f, 0.400f, 0.750f),
        glm::vec3(0.050f, 0.000f, 0.000f),
        colSkinMain
    );

    // Cráneo
    addBox(
        glm::vec3(0.000f, 0.550f, 0.450f),
        glm::vec3(0.500f, 0.250f, 0.400f),
        glm::vec3(0.150f, 0.000f, 0.000f),
        colSkinMain
    );

    // Ojo_Base_L
    addBox(
        glm::vec3(-0.250f, 0.700f, 0.500f),
        glm::vec3(0.180f, 0.180f, 0.180f),
        glm::vec3(0.000f, 0.000f, 0.000f),
        colSkinMain
    );

    // Iris_L
    addBox(
        glm::vec3(-0.250f, 0.720f, 0.550f),
        glm::vec3(0.120f, 0.120f, 0.050f),
        glm::vec3(0.000f, 0.000f, 0.000f),
        colEyeGold
    );

    // Pupila_L
    addBox(
        glm::vec3(-0.250f, 0.720f, 0.580f),
        glm::vec3(0.060f, 0.030f, 0.020f),
        glm::vec3(0.000f, 0.000f, 0.000f),
        colBlack
    );

    // Ojo_Base_R
    addBox(
        glm::vec3(0.250f, 0.700f, 0.500f),
        glm::vec3(0.180f, 0.180f, 0.180f),
        glm::vec3(0.000f, 0.000f, 0.000f),
        colSkinMain
    );

    // Iris_R
    addBox(
        glm::vec3(0.250f, 0.720f, 0.550f),
        glm::vec3(0.120f, 0.120f, 0.050f),
        glm::vec3(0.000f, 0.000f, 0.000f),
        colEyeGold
    );

    // Pupila_R
    addBox(
        glm::vec3(0.250f, 0.720f, 0.580f),
        glm::vec3(0.060f, 0.030f, 0.020f),
        glm::vec3(0.000f, 0.000f, 0.000f),
        colBlack
    );

    // Glandula_L
    addBox(
        glm::vec3(-0.300f, 0.650f, 0.300f),
        glm::vec3(0.150f, 0.100f, 0.250f),
        glm::vec3(0.200f, -0.200f, 0.000f),
        colWart
    );

    // Glandula_R
    addBox(
        glm::vec3(0.300f, 0.650f, 0.300f),
        glm::vec3(0.150f, 0.100f, 0.250f),
        glm::vec3(0.200f, 0.200f, -0.000f),
        colWart
    );

    // Brazo_L
    addBox(
        glm::vec3(-0.350f, 0.350f, 0.400f),
        glm::vec3(0.120f, 0.400f, 0.120f),
        glm::vec3(0.400f, 0.200f, 0.500f),
        colSkinMain
    );

    // Mano_L
    addBox(
        glm::vec3(-0.400f, 0.050f, 0.550f),
        glm::vec3(0.250f, 0.020f, 0.250f),
        glm::vec3(0.000f, 0.400f, 0.000f),
        colSkinMain
    );

    // Brazo_R
    addBox(
        glm::vec3(0.350f, 0.350f, 0.400f),
        glm::vec3(0.120f, 0.400f, 0.120f),
        glm::vec3(0.400f, -0.200f, -0.500f),
        colSkinMain
    );

    // Mano_R
    addBox(
        glm::vec3(0.400f, 0.050f, 0.550f),
        glm::vec3(0.250f, 0.020f, 0.250f),
        glm::vec3(0.000f, -0.400f, 0.000f),
        colSkinMain
    );

    // Muslo_Tras_L
    addBox(
        glm::vec3(-0.500f, 0.300f, -0.300f),
        glm::vec3(0.200f, 0.350f, 0.450f),
        glm::vec3(0.200f, 0.500f, 0.000f),
        colSkinMain
    );

    // Pie_Tras_L
    addBox(
        glm::vec3(-0.550f, 0.050f, -0.400f),
        glm::vec3(0.300f, 0.030f, 0.500f),
        glm::vec3(0.000f, 0.600f, 0.000f),
        colSkinMain
    );

    // Muslo_Tras_R
    addBox(
        glm::vec3(0.500f, 0.300f, -0.300f),
        glm::vec3(0.200f, 0.350f, 0.450f),
        glm::vec3(0.200f, -0.500f, 0.000f),
        colSkinMain
    );

    // Pie_Tras_R
    addBox(
        glm::vec3(0.550f, 0.050f, -0.400f),
        glm::vec3(0.300f, 0.030f, 0.500f),
        glm::vec3(0.000f, -0.600f, 0.000f),
        colSkinMain
    );

}
